Revise a published ETR when the P50 moves by more than the margin the procedure sets. [1] A move of that margin or less is logged but not released. [2] A revised ETR needs the same approvals as the original global ETR, from the Incident Commander and the Duty Manager. [3] The model is also re-run at each operational period change. [4] This is in DOM 14.206.
